details:
I'm using [TTS Voice Wizard](https://ttsvoicewizard.com/) for speech-to-text communication in VRChat as a mute, and VRChat 2026.3.3 Build `1919` broke my speech-to-text setup. OSC opens the keyboard, but doesn't fill in the message to input in Build `1919`.

This issue is not reproducible in the previous VRChat 2026.3.2p2 Build `1903`.

The attached two videos show the VRChat keyboard behavior from both Build `1902` (not affected) and Build `1919` (affected), without restarting TTS Voice Wizard in between.

Steps to reproduce:

1. Download TTS Voice Wizard, and optionally setup [Whisper](https://ttsvoicewizard.com/docs/SpeechRecognitionMethods/Whisper) as a local speech-to-text provider instead of the default System Speech.

2. Enable "Show Keyboard Before Sending Message" in TTS Voice Wizard Settings.

3. Go to "Text to Speech" tab in VRChat and press the "Speech to Text to Speech" button to start audio recognition (Whisper) and enable speech-to-text.

4. Try using your voice to send a chatbox message via OSC to VRChat.

5. Repeat with "Show Keyboard Before Sending Message" disabled in TTS Voice Wizard Settings.

See the videos.

Expected result: The chatbox input should open on voice activation when "Show Keyboard Before Sending Message" is enabled, and the speech-to-text message should be added to the VRChat keyboard input in Build `1919`.

Actual result: The chatbox input opens on voice activation when "Show Keyboard Before Sending Message" is enabled, but the VRChat chatbox input will be empty in Build `1919` (works in Build `1902`). TTS Voice Wizard logs the message correctly in logs. The message from TTS Voice Wizard via OSC can only be sent if "Show Keyboard Before Sending Message" is disabled.
title: [1919] The new keyboard doesn't accept text input from OSC chatbox messages (TTS Voice Wizard speech-to-text)
